$description: Tabs orientation="vertical" (platform/components/Tabs, library wave 7, lane A): the vertical tab list's tokens. Each tab is a navigation list row (NavList's item tokens): the hover fill, the open tab in the selected state. The other Tabs tokens stay in components.tokens.json.

tabs-vertical-gap.$description: Vertical tabs: the space between the tab list and the panel.

tabs-vertical-list-width.$description: Vertical tabs: the tab list's width (longer names wrap).

tabs-vertical-list-row-gap.$description: Vertical tabs: the space between two tabs (the navigation list's).

tabs-vertical-tab-radius.$description: Vertical tab: its corners (a navigation list row's).

tabs-vertical-tab-text.$description: Vertical tab: its name (a navigation list row's).

tabs-vertical-tab-font-weight.$description: Vertical tab: its name's weight (the open tab is heavier).

tabs-vertical-tab-min-height.$description: Vertical tab: its least height (the standard control height).

tabs-vertical-tab-padding-inline.$description: Vertical tab: the space at its sides.

tabs-vertical-tab-hover-background.$description: Vertical tab with the pointer over it: the hover fill.

tabs-vertical-tab-hover-shadow.$description: Vertical tab with the pointer over it: the hover edge.

tabs-vertical-tab-hover-text.$description: Vertical tab with the pointer over it: its name.

tabs-vertical-tab-selected-background.$description: Open vertical tab: the selected fill (the navigation pane's current row).

tabs-vertical-tab-selected-shadow.$description: Open vertical tab: the selected edge.

tabs-vertical-tab-selected-text.$description: Open vertical tab: its name in the selected content color.

tabs-vertical-tab-selected-font-weight.$description: Open vertical tab: its name's weight.
